V8_walls_raycast.method: inward ray from area-weighted surface samples (trimesh/embree), thickness = first exit; every thin structural sample is re-checked in the XY slice at its height (ThinMap): 'wall' = strip >= 2 mm long thinner than 1.2 (fail), 'corner' = acute-corner tip / short stub (warn), 'edge_z_only' = XY section >= 1.2 wide there (stepped edge round seen by a vertical ray, warn); sculpt: 'edge' = the strip lies within 0.6 of the >= 1.2 core of the body one layer up or down (tapering edge of a sculpted wall, warn), 'plate' = a horizontal face sample (|n_z| > 0.99) >= 1.0 inside its XY section (a thin horizontal shell, fail)

rib_back.note: rays at clipped / rounded rib ends; rib body width checked in V8_ribs

V8_walls_layers.method: per layer mid-height: pieces of slice - opening(slice, 1.2) (>= 0.02 mm^2), classified 'wall' (strip >= 2 mm long) or 'corner' (acute-corner tip / stub); w_est = local width estimate; sculpt: a strip within 0.6 of the >= 1.2 core of the body one layer up or down is the tapering 'edge' of a sculpted wall (warn, area reported), one thin in both neighbours a 'wall'

V8_back_plate.criterion: >= 2.0 under the low cavity (band sweep + wheel, cut to the plate top z 2.0)

V8_roof.criterion: >= 2.0 (vertical; interior = more than 1.05 from where the surface comes down to the underside)

V8_plates.criterion: >= 1.2 (vertical; interior = more than 1.05 from where the surface comes down to the underside)

V8_fingers.criterion: >= 4.29 (chord perpendicular to the finger axis, pallet centre -> root)

band_height.criterion: >= 1.2 (vertical, from the band bottom z 3.2; full band 4.4)

V8_legs.criterion: >= 7.0 (chord perpendicular to A->B where the leg is not under the face)
V8_legs.note: narrowed near the pallet end A by WheelEx2D = SweptInv(disc(O, 14.90)) - the SPEC's own HeadBand2D definition; the narrowed section sees less bending than the full-width root

band_height.criterion: >= 1.2 (vertical, from the band bottom z 3.2; full band 4.4)

V8_slivers_2d.criterion: no sliver (strip >= 2 mm long) narrower than 1.6 in Fill2D (pads excluded) / Roof2D
V8_slivers_2d.note: the sculpt frame has no Fill2D / Roof2D walls (the sections are not in its body); its thin walls are judged by V8_walls_layers / V8_walls_raycast

V8_stop_pads.criterion: pads are <= 0.6 thick by construction ([Rot(Leg) (+) 0.55] - Swept(HB)); every part must be backed by the fill wall (no free fin > 0.8 long)

V8_ribs.criterion: rib pieces reach the designed width 0.8

V8_slivers_frame_layers.criterion: no sliver narrower than 1.6 in the frame's Fill2D / Roof2D walls
V8_slivers_frame_layers.note: the sculpt frame has no Fill2D / Roof2D walls (z 2.6 - 10.4 holds the sculpt and its envelope cuts); its thin walls are judged against 1.2 by V8_walls_layers / V8_walls_raycast

V9_overhangs.criterion: faces > 45.0 deg from vertical (+0.5 deg tol) must be bed, listed bridge (roof <= 13.5, umbrella plate <= 10.5, bores D 8.7), listed rib float (pitch <= 4.5, gap 0.40) or chamfer micro-step <= 0.3; sculpt: the first layer is bed; an underside overhanging its own layer below by <= 1.0 and oblique sculpted overhangs reaching <= 1.0 per layer are 'sculpt_overhang' (warn); other undersides ('sculpt_float') need every point within 1.0 of own material below or 1.90 of any body's top <= gap_z + z_lift + floor_rest below, or on a straight strand <= 13.5 between such anchors
